recognize_zh: 免疫染色呈純細胞核陽性，大量大型不規則的腫瘤細胞核被染成深棕色，小淋巴球多為陰性；陽性比例很高、強度不一，最像 Ki-67 高增生指數，反映 ALCL 屬於高度惡性淋巴瘤。
features: Nuclear-only brown staining in a large fraction of cells
Positive nuclei are large, irregular and pleomorphic, with variable staining intensity
Granular to coarse speckled nuclear staining pattern in some cells
Many small background lymphocytes and stromal nuclei are negative
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain of a lymph node shows nuclear positivity in a large proportion of cells, predominantly large pleomorphic tumor nuclei, with variable intensity and a speckled pattern in some cells. Small background lymphocytes and stromal cells are largely negative, and there is no cytoplasmic or membranous staining. The antibody is not labeled; the purely nuclear pattern in a high fraction of tumor cells is most consistent with Ki-67, indicating a high proliferation index. Findings support a high-grade lymphoma, consistent with anaplastic large cell lymphoma in context.

ddx.vs: ALK in NPM1::ALK-positive ALCL gives combined nuclear and cytoplasmic staining, whereas this stain is purely nuclear.
Proliferation markers in Hodgkin lymphoma highlight scattered large cells and reactive cells rather than sheets of large pleomorphic nuclei.
DLBCL can have a similar high Ki-67 fraction, so B-cell versus T-cell/CD30/ALK markers, not the proliferation index, separate them.

stain: IHC: nuclear marker, presumed Ki-67 (not labeled)
